precipitation_operator: same-water-year consecutive-date difference of cumulative SNOTEL PREC; differences below -1e-9 mm rejected and smaller floating residuals canonicalized to zero; gaps and water-year resets not bridged
water_year_operator: matched October-1 cumulative boundary to September-30 cumulative boundary; fixture sum covers start < date <= end (October 2 through September 30); both boundaries and complete matched fixture interval required; not a complete-water-year-total claim
temperature_operator: daily finite exact-date tmax and tmin; fixture-minus-SNOTEL bias, MAE, Pearson correlation
